subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: The Procurement Cycle
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Procurement Cycle.

hook.text: From 'we need this' to 'it's on the shelf' involves seven steps most people never see.

buildup.text: The cycle starts with identifying the need and ends with payment and performance review.

discovery.text: Steps: need identification, specification, supplier search, evaluation, negotiation, ordering, and review.

twist.text: Skipping steps—like jumping straight to ordering—causes overspending, poor quality, and supply failures.

climax.text: Mature procurement teams follow every step for major purchases and streamline for routine repeat buys.

punchline.text: Follow the cycle or pay the price of shortcuts.

quiz.question: What happens when procurement cycle steps are skipped?
options: Overspending, poor quality, and supply failures
